pages.text: The $(l)Plushie Kitsune$() is a toy based on Japanese folklore. It is a mystical fighter with unique defensive and regenerative capabilities.

pages.title: Combat Statistics
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 30$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 20$(li)$(6)Damage:$() 6.5$(br2)Immunities: $(b)Wither, Levitation, and Fire$().$(br2)Special technique: $(b)Japanese Teleportation$() — when it deals damage or is attacked by an enemy, it teleports and heals one heart.
It's anything but, but it's not as expensive as it seems.
